name: How long does a typical copper repiping project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical copper repiping project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a copper repiping project depends on the size of your home and the complexity of its plumbing system. Generally, most residential repipes can be completed within 3 to 5 business days. This timeframe includes draining the system, installing new pipes, connecting fixtures, and pressure testing. For larger homes or more intricate layouts, it might take a bit longer. To ensure process clarity, CG Plumbing Solutions aims to minimize disruption and will provide a detailed timeline upfront, often completing the work efficiently to restore your water service promptly.
